name: 1-(benzofuran-5-yl)-N-[(2-methoxyphenyl)methyl]propan-2-amine
summary: 5-APB-NBOMe, also known as N-(2-methoxybenzyl)-5-(2-aminopropyl)benzofuran, is a drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, benzofuran, and 25-NB (NBOMe) families related to the entactogen and mildly psychedelic drug 5-APB. It is the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) derivative of 5-APB. The preclinical pharmacokinetics of 5-APB-NBOMe have been studied. The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Germany in 2014.

uses.text: The preclinical pharmacokinetics of 5-APB-NBOMe have been studied. The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Germany in 2014.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Other NBOMe drugs have been linked to seizures, dangerous overheating, high blood pressure, severe agitation and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。其他 NBOMe 類藥物曾與癲癇發作、危險的體溫過高、高血壓、嚴重躁動和死亡有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。其他 NBOMe 类药物曾与癫痫发作、危险的体温过高、高血压、严重躁动和死亡有关。

fact.en: 5-APB-NBOMe adds the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) group of the NBOMe drugs to 5-APB, a benzofuran relative of MDA. It was first found on the drug market in Germany in 2014.
fact.zh: 5-APB-NBOMe 是在 MDA 的苯并呋喃近親 5-APB 上，加上 NBOMe 類藥物的 N-(2-甲氧基苄基)。它在 2014 年首次於德國的毒品市場被發現。
fact.zhHans: 5-APB-NBOMe 是在 MDA 的苯并呋喃近亲 5-APB 上，加上 NBOMe 类药物的 N-(2-甲氧基苄基)。它在 2014 年首次于德国的毒品市场被发现。
